stem: Identify and explain ONE effect that the removal of mice would have on the food web.
instruction: Review the food web carefully. Then enter your answer and your explanation in the box provided.
visual_elements: A food web is shown. Diagram shows grasses eaten by rabbits, grasshoppers, and mice; grasshoppers eaten by lizards; lizards, snakes, and rabbits eaten by hawks; mice eaten by hawks and snakes.
